title: Al Khalidi Hospital & Medical Center — doctors listed on khmc.jo and hospital details
notes: The site has no single complete directory: /en/doctors/ lists 44 (cardiology, pediatrics, anesthesia); other doctors appear only on specialty/department pages (urology, nephrology, GI, endocrinology, orthopedics AR-only) or as stand-alone profile pages in page-sitemap.xml. All 239 sitemap pages were fetched and every .team-member card harvested (296 cards, 132 distinct name strings in EN+AR), then EN and AR spellings of the same doctor were paired by hand (61 practitioners). The site spells the same doctor differently across pages (e.g. Rajai Samrin/Samreen, Aseel Qtaishat/Qutaishat, Ahmed Hashma/Ahmad Heshmeh) - kept in extra.name_en_variants/name_ar_variants. 5 doctors are AR-only (no EN listing). specialty = the published EN headline verbatim (e.g. "Consultant Cardiologist"), AR headline when no EN; grade only when the headline says consultant/specialist (or professor). Profile bios kept verbatim in extra.bio_en/bio_ar (qualifications not split out). Facility capacity figures conflict between pages (10 vs 7 ORs; 20 vs 25 ICU beds) - both recorded. No insurer list, schedules or fees published. robots.txt (Yoast) allows these pages.
